knownLimitations: Seed-packet maturity conventions vary by crop and seed company; the UI explains the modeled distinction between transplant maturity and indoor seedling lead time.
Soil temperature is an optional gardener-entered measurement; the tool does not infer soil temperature from air temperature.
Row-cover and low-tunnel extensions are conservative planning allowances, not local microclimate guarantees.
Temporary shade is modeled as an establishment aid only and does not alter ambient forecast temperature.
The six-week queue is a crop-calendar work queue using climatology and biology; it deliberately does not project today's NWS forecast into future weeks.
Hot-climate mode still relies primarily on current 7-day heat plus crop class; climatological heat normals or GDD would improve long-range precision.
